Box office collection

[edit | edit source]

The following is the list of highest-grossing Tamil films released in 2025. The rank of the films in the following table depends on the estimate of worldwide collections as reported by organizations classified as green by Wikipedia.The total collections of all movies is 1,519 crores [a] There is no official tracking of domestic box office figures within India.

  Background shading indicates that a film is currently showing in theatres worldwide.
